description: This file defines the IEventHubDataAdapter interface for the Orleans streaming platform, specifically tailored for Event Hubs. It extends data adapter interfaces for queue and cache data, providing methods for message conversion, position retrieval, and stream identification related to Event Hubs.

classes.name: IEventHubDataAdapter
classes.description: Interface for adapting EventData messages for Orleans streaming, with methods for message conversion, position management, and stream identification.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts an EventData message into a CachedMessage, including position and dequeue details.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the StreamPosition from an EventData message and partition information.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Extracts the offset string from a CachedMessage.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Obtains the partition key associated with a given StreamId.

methods.name: GetStreamIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves the StreamId for a given EventData message.
